description: Audit GitHub workflow files under a repo path for least-privilege problems: missing or write-all permissions, per-job grants broader than the job's steps need, pull_request_target or workflow_run or issue_comment triggers combined with a checkout of the PR head, secrets in fork-reachable contexts, secrets: inherit to reusable workflows, self-hosted runners on PR triggers, cache poisoning surface, whole-workspace artifact uploads, missing timeouts, and missing concurrency guards on deploy-shaped jobs. Returns a HARDENED, REVIEW, or EXPOSED verdict with file, job, and line evidence per finding, plus a hardened permissions plan per job.

path.description: Repo root, a .github/workflows directory, or a single workflow file

name: audit_workflows
